name: elevenlabs-mcp
description: ElevenLabs MCP server: drive the ElevenLabs voice-agent platform from any MCP client - discover voices, manage the TTS voice library, and generate text-to-speech audio. Install as a Hermes plugin to wire ElevenLabs into your Hermes workflow via MCP tools (elevenlabs_generate_speech, elevenlabs_list_voices, elevenlabs_create_voice, etc.).
